tools.name: speak
tools.description: Turn text into speech with Speakvora. Returns a URL to the audio. Phonon and Pocket voices start speaking in tens of milliseconds. Numbers must be written out in words for languages other than English. Counts against the account's characters (100,000 free every month).

tools.description: List Speakvora voices and the languages they speak.

tools.name: search_phrases
tools.description: Find ready-made phrases in the Speakvora library by words. Library phrases play instantly.
